# Cost of Living & Quality of Life — cost.extrautil.com

A free, static client-side web tool that synthesizes US federal public-domain
datasets and aggregated international quality-of-life indices into a single
comparable dashboard for 40 major US cities + 20 top global countries.

## How to use programmatically

URL: https://cost.extrautil.com/?{params}

Parameters:
  p      Place id. US city slugs: nyc, san_jose, irvine, boston, san_diego,
         san_franc, oakland, honolulu, seattle, jersey_cty, plus 30 more
         (los_angeles, chicago, washington, miami, atlanta, dallas, houston,
         austin, denver, phoenix, las_vegas, portland, philadelphia,
         minneapolis, detroit, charlotte, orlando, tampa, pittsburgh, st_louis,
         baltimore, cincinnati, cleveland, kansas_city, indianapolis, columbus,
         nashville, raleigh, salt_lake, albuquerque, oklahoma_cy, memphis).
         Country ids: ISO-2 codes (LU, NL, DK, OM, CH, FI, NO, IS, AT, DE,
         AU, NZ, SE, US, EE, QA, JP, ES, SI, HR).
  s      User salary (USD/year). Triggers the affordability gauge for US cities.
  r      Ranking table mode: us | country  (default: us).
  theme  light | dark
  embed  1 to render in embed mode

Example:
  https://cost.extrautil.com/?p=austin&s=120000

## Data layers and computation

US cities:
  estimated_living_wage = $45,000 × (RPP / 100)            # MIT methodology
  comfortable_salary    = source: Visual Capitalist 2025 (top 10) or
                           = $95,000 × (RPP / 100)         # for 30 derived metros
  rent_2br              = HUD Fair Market Rents
  median_household_income = Census ACS 5-year
  median_wage           = BLS OEWS metro/state median, all occupations
  rpp                   = BEA Regional Price Parity (US=100)

Countries:
  numbeo_index          = Numbeo Quality of Life Index
  ceo_score             = CEO World Quality of Life Score
  effective_pp          = purchasingPower × (100 / costOfLiving)
  radar (8 axes)        = Numbeo sub-indices (Safety, Health, Purchasing
                          Power, Cleanness, Climate, Affordability,
                          Property Affordability, Commute)

## Data freshness

Data is baked in at deploy time (static client-side site). Refresh cadences:
  BEA RPP             — annual (Dec)
  HUD Fair Market Rents — annual (Oct)
  BLS OEWS wages     — annual (Mar/Apr)
  Census ACS          — annual (Dec)
  CDC / FBI / EPA     — annual
  Numbeo              — quarterly snapshot

scripts/refresh-data.py documents the regeneration procedure.

## Source files

  data.js      — snapshot: US_CITIES, COUNTRIES, NATIONAL_* baselines, source vintage
  cost.js      — math: resolvePlace, summarizeCity, summarizeCountry,
                 rankUsCities, rankCountries, affordabilityGauge, searchPlaces
  index.html   — UI; vanilla, single-file
  tests/       — node --test suite, 28 tests
  scripts/     — refresh-data.py for documented data regeneration

## What this tool is not

  - Not a real-time price feed.
  - Not store-by-store, county-level for all 3,144 US counties (yet).
  - Not a personal cost-of-living index — it's an aggregate model.
  - Not financial, relocation, or career advice.

## Sources

  BEA RPPs:    https://www.bea.gov/data/prices-inflation/regional-price-parities-state-and-metro-area
  HUD FMR:     https://www.huduser.gov/portal/datasets/fmr.html
  BLS OEWS:    https://www.bls.gov/oes/
  Census ACS:  https://www.census.gov/programs-surveys/acs/data.html
  CDC NCHS:    https://www.cdc.gov/nchs/
  FBI UCR:     https://ucr.fbi.gov/
  Numbeo:      https://www.numbeo.com/quality-of-life/rankings_by_country.jsp
  CEO World:   https://ceoworld.biz/
  MIT Living Wage: https://livingwage.mit.edu/

Part of extrautil.com — a collection of free, practical, privacy-friendly tools.
